rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with the Files.com platform to enable AI-driven file transfer and management operations. Provides tools for uploading and downloading files, querying folder contents, managing users, and orchestrating workflows across multiple cloud storage providers including Amazon S3, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, SharePoint, Google Drive, and protocols like SFTP and AS2. Features strict access controls, audit logging, and API key authentication.
